newsitem.title: UK: BT phone could replace switchboards-paper.
newsitem.headline: BT phone could replace switchboards-paper.

text.p: British Telecommunications Plc is close to launching a new mobile telephone service which could replace conventional office switchboards, the Financial Times said on Thursday.

The paper said the new service, called OnePhone, will combine fixed line and mobile operations into one service enabling subscribers to use a single handset at their desks, away from their desks and outside the office.
OnePhone is being developed in conjunction with Ericsson of Sweden.

It is being tested by BT staff and commercial trials are set to being toward the end of the year, the paper said. Full commercial service for business customers is planned for next spring. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
